name: Every context line owns an exact source, not merely the digest point source
Context refs from another FO, epoch or changed bytes are rejected
SDK forwards same-FO canonical before and after cursors independently
Window preserves exact before/source/after order and user roles
Other-host or other-FO windows and gaps cannot be stitched
Missing source cannot be replaced by available neighboring entries
More-before uses the outer cursor and retains sequence identity
